nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Query traffic keyword lists for an Amazon ASIN via Nexscope, including traffic source type, conversion type, organic rank, and ad rank with historical month and multi-dimensional sorting. Trigger when user mentions ASIN reverse traffic keywords, traffic keyword list, keyword traffic structure, organic/ad keyword analysis, keyword conversion type, Nexscope traffic keyword, Amazon traffic keywords, reverse ASIN keywords — even if "Nexscope" is not explicitly mentioned, as long as the need involves viewing keyword traffic sources and keyword lists for a specific ASIN.

asin.description: Product ASIN to reverse lookup; max length 1000

badges.description: Traffic keyword type (impression position), see [Badges Enum](#badges-enum)

conversionKeywordTypes.description: Comma-separated conversion types: excellent, stable, lost, invalid

marketplace.description: Marketplace site, default US: US, JP, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, CA, IN

month.description: Historical month in yyyyMM format; omit for the latest 30 days

orderDesc.description: Whether to sort in descending order

orderField.description: Sort field, default rankPosition; see documented orderField options

size.description: Items per page, default 50, from 1 to 100; at most 2000 records can be queried

name: nexscope_amazon_traffic_keywords
title: Amazon Traffic Keywords
